activity_summary: Kemp met you on the way up and mended a child's dance. She asked him again at once, and he did it again. Thomas Pope was on the road to the house and told him to come. You kept the garland that went over the mud.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Mended the dance twice and stopped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Told him to give the second, and kept the garland.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Called him off the lane and walked up with you.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: On a May morning a man does not refuse a child a second foot.
